scenes.summary: Xaihi introduces the details of Control Nexus expansions. Upgrades will provide opportunities for optimizing your Manufacturing Cabin and add a new type of cabin: Growth Chambers.

lines.text: Endmin, we have completed preparations for the Control Nexus expansion upgrades.
This upgrade will connect the Control Nexus to a suite of auxiliary algorithmic modules that we just finished repairing.
This will allow us to fine tune system controls, unlock Manufacturing Cabin upgrades, and improve our work performance.
A larger, mid-sized cabin will also be restored for our utilization. Construction and management of the ⟦key|Growth Chamber⟧ will become available.
The Engineering Division has prepared an Algorithm Expansion Chip. However, you must personally authorize its installation.
Please go to the ⟦key|Control Nexus⟧ to install the chip and update the system framework.

options: Let's start. What should I do?

r: Let's start. What should I do?

scenes.summary: Xaihi introduces the functions of the Growth Chamber. You can use it to grow and harvest various fungal matter, vitrified plants, and rare minerals.

lines.text: Control Nexus data updates verified. We can now construct a ⟦key|Growth Chamber⟧ at the Working Sector.
Of course, if that is what you need.
Seed materials extracted from various resources can be cultivated into mature ⟦key|fungal matter⟧, ⟦key|vitrified plants⟧, and ⟦key|rare minerals⟧.
Cultivation takes time, but it offers a steady supply of these resources.
The Growth Chamber must be constructed at an available mid-sized empty cabin in the Working Sector. Endmin, I believe we can start constructing one right away.

options: What can we do with the Growth Chamber?
Does that mean we can farm on Dijiang?
Steady supply? I like the sound of that.

scenes.summary: The Growth Chamber is now cultivating materials as intended. It can be expanded in the future to grow additional types of materials and increase its production volume.

lines.text: Endmin, I am receiving operational log from the Growth Chamber.
Indeed. When gathering rare materials from the outdoors, ⟦key|keep some at hand⟧, and extract seed materials from them. This will generate a positive feedback loop.
We can also upgrade the Growth Chamber to expand its scale of production, as well as the type of materials it can cultivate.
Yes, we do. In fact, the Engineering Division has already made a two-year schedule. We have prioritized certain tasks to better support the Crisis Team.
I shall not take up any more of your time. You shall be notified once our repair work makes important new progress.
